Newly generated chunks automatically replace generated lanterns with Torchmaster Feral Flare Lanterns. Normal runtime lantern placements are tracked and excluded from conversion.

For lanterns that already existed before this mod was installed, Minecraft did not record whether they were generated or player-placed. Choosing conversion can therefore replace pre-install player-built lanterns.
Back up this world before converting existing chunks.
